summary: Step-sheet edit whitelist (STEP_SHEET_EDITOR_EMAILS) enforced end-to-end. All 11 backend pytest cases pass and all 3 frontend user-role UI checks pass. Only Jamin (whitelist) can edit step sheets; admin@stompinground.com and fresh self-serve instructors are blocked in both the API (403 with body 'Only Erin or Jamin can edit step sheets') and the UI (edit-step-sheet pencil and instr-edit-* buttons hidden). Non-editor POST /api/dances and POST /api/dances/import silently blank step_sheet / step_sheet_image. Non-step-sheet metadata edits still respect owner-or-admin gating (self-serve instructor gets 403 on seeded dances they don't own, admin can edit metadata). Deprecated warnings expo-notifications web + props.pointerEvents were observed but are pre-existing cosmetic issues, already reported in iteration_9.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing console warning on web: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' Guard registerForPushNotifications with Platform.OS !== 'web'. Reference: already flagged in iteration_9.
Pre-existing deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Reference: already flagged in iteration_9.

action_items: None required for this feature — behavior matches spec.

(Optional cleanup carried over from iteration_9) Silence expo-notifications web warning by guarding push registration with Platform.OS !== 'web'; migrate deprecated pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py user_can_edit_step_sheets(user) correctly uses lowercase email lookup against STEP_SHEET_EDITOR_EMAILS with no admin bypass — matches PRD.

update_dance cleanly separates step-sheet permission (whitelist only) from other-field permission (owner OR admin OR whitelist), so senior instructors on the whitelist can also edit metadata of dances they don't own — required because all 507 seeded dances were owned by the deleted Erin user_id.
create_dance and import_dances silently blank step_sheet/step_sheet_image for non-editors (do not 400/403), which is intentional per spec ('silently stripped') and confirmed working.

Frontend /dance/[id].tsx line 211 gates the pencil on user?.can_edit_step_sheets, and /(tabs)/instructor.tsx line 261 gates the 'Sheet' button on user.can_edit_step_sheets. GET /api/auth/me returns this flag in user_to_out().

server.py is 1496 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, dances, classes, suggestions, chat, notifications) in a future refactor. Not blocking this iteration.
